The daily loop of the lead, from claiming a feature to finishing it: dispatch tasks, verify and apply what comes back, merge, run the suite once, finish. When a member reports, before you apply anything: qargi local verify RUN This compares every ref of the real repository with the snapshot taken by prepare. A change means the member wrote where it
